mapper.sql: a.id, a.username, a.status, p.full_name AS fullName, p.claimed_student_no AS claimedStudentNo, p.student_no AS studentNo, p.department, p.major, p.verification_status AS verificationStatus
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password_hash AS passwordHash FROM user_account WHERE username = #{username} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT id, username FROM user_account WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT , p.invite_code AS inviteCode FROM user_account a LEFT JOIN student_profile p ON p.user_id = a.id WHERE a.id = #{id}
SELECT r.role_code FROM role r JOIN user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{id} ORDER BY r.role_code
SELECT id FROM role WHERE role_code = 'ADMIN' FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_account a JOIN user_role ur ON ur.user_id = a.id JOIN role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE a.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.role_code = 'ADMIN'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_profile(user_id, claimed_student_no, full_name, department, major) VALUES(#{id}, #{claimedStudentNo}, #{fullName}, #{department}, #{major})
INSERT INTO user_role(user_id, role_id) SELECT #{id}, id FROM role WHERE role_code = #{role}
mapper.update: UPDATE user_account SET status = #{status}, deleted_at = #{deletedAt} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE student_profile SET student_no = #{studentNo}, full_name = #{fullName}, verification_status = #{status}, verified_by = #{actorId}, verified_at = #{now}, invite_code = #{inviteCode} WHERE user_id = #{id}
UPDATE student_profile SET invite_code = #{inviteCode} WHERE user_id = #{id} AND verification_status = 'VERIFIED'

where.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_role ur JOIN role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = a.id AND r.role_code = #{role})

mapper.select: SELECT FROM user_account a LEFT JOIN student_profile p ON p.user_id = a.id ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_account a LEFT JOIN student_profile p ON p.user_id = a.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log(actor_id, action, target_type, target_key, change_summary, created_at) VALUES(#{actorId}, #{action}, #{type}, #{target}, #{summary}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT l.id, l.actor_id AS actorId, l.action, l.target_type AS targetType, l.target_key AS targetKey, l.change_summary AS changeSummary, l.created_at AS createdAt, actor.username AS actorName, COALESCE(c.name, account.username) AS targetName, p.version_no AS publicationVersion, p.correction_reason AS publicationReason FROM audit_log l LEFT JOIN user_account actor ON actor.id = l.actor_id LEFT JOIN competition c ON c.id = CASE WHEN l.target_type = 'COMPETITION' AND l.target_key REGEXP '^[0-9]{1,19}$' THEN CAST(l.target_key AS UNSIGNED) END LEFT JOIN user_account account ON account.id = CASE WHEN l.target_type = 'ACCOUNT' AND l.target_key REGEXP '^[0-9]{1,19}$' THEN CAST(l.target_key AS UNSIGNED) END LEFT JOIN result_publication p ON p.competition_id = c.id AND p.id = CASE WHEN l.action IN ('RESULT_FIRST','RESULT_CORRECTION') AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(l.change_summary, '$.publicationId')) = 'INTEGER' THEN CAST(l.change_summary ->> '$.publicationId' AS UNSIGNED) END ORDER BY l.created_at DESC, l.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
